bylaw: Zoning and Development By-law No. 3575, City of Vancouver
review_note: Transcribed from the published district schedules and Council reports. Figures listed under `unverified` for a district could not be checked against the current schedule text and are flagged in the analysis. Overlays (Broadway Plan, Villages, Transit-Oriented Areas, heritage, view cones) are not applied unless entered.

use_classes.assembly: Cultural, recreational and institutional (community centre, church, school, hall)
use_classes.care: Care and supportive housing (community care facility, seniors supportive housing)

toa.note: Provincial Transit-Oriented Areas (Local Government Act Part 14 Div. 7 / Vancouver Charter s. 565.06, Bill 47, in force 30 June 2024): a municipality may not refuse residential development below these minimums within a designated TOA. Distances are from the station entrance or bus exchange.

alias_note.RS-1: The RS districts were replaced by R1-1 (Residential Inclusive) on 17 October 2023; the Open Data layer may still carry the old label.
alias_note.RM-4N: RM-4N shares the RM-4 schedule with a neighbourhood grocery store provision.
alias_note.C-2B: C-2 family: figures taken from the C-2 schedule; confirm the sub-district's own schedule.

R1-1.label: Residential Inclusive

use_notes.retail: neighbourhood grocery store only (corner-store provision); general retail is not a listed use
use_notes.dwelling: one-family and two-family dwellings, and multiplex up to 6 units (8 where all units are secured rental)

notes: FSR 0.70 for a one-family or two-family dwelling and as the multiplex base; 1.00 for a multiplex where the building is all secured rental, includes a below-market ownership unit, or makes the City amenity contribution.
Multiplex unit count by site: 3–4 units on ≥ 306 m² and 10.0 m frontage; 5 units on ≥ 464 m² and 13.4 m; 6 units on ≥ 557 m² and 15.1 m; up to 8 units where all are secured rental.
Site coverage 50 % is the §3.2 house / duplex regulation; the §3.1 multiplex regulations set no coverage limit but cap impermeable surfaces.
Height 11.5 m and 3 storeys is the multiplex limit; a one-family dwelling or duplex is limited to a lower envelope (confirm §4.3).

RT-7.label: Two-Family Dwelling (Kitsilano)
notes: FSR 0.60 outright; the June 2024 multiplex amendment lets RT-7 and RT-9 sites use the R1-1 multiplex density (1.0) with the R1-1 unit and site minimums.
Yards are not encoded for RT-7 (the schedule relates them to the existing streetscape); enter them from §4.4–4.6 in the Lot panel.

RT-8.label: Two-Family Dwelling (Kitsilano)
notes: FSR 0.50 outright; the Director of Planning may permit up to 0.75 for single detached house, duplex, infill, multiple conversion dwelling, multiple dwelling and seniors housing.
At least half the units in a building must have two or more bedrooms.

RT-10.label: Two-Family Dwelling (Riley Park)
notes: Only FSR and site coverage are encoded; enter height and yards from the schedule.

RM-1.label: Multiple Dwelling (low density)

use_notes.dwelling: one-family and two-family dwellings outright; multiple dwelling is a conditional approval use

notes: FSR 0.40 outright; up to 0.65 with retention of a heritage building. Height and yards not encoded.

RM-4.label: Multiple Dwelling (apartment)

use_notes.dwelling: one-family and two-family dwellings outright; multiple dwelling and mixed-use residential are conditional approval uses

notes: Height 10.7 m outright. The schedule permits a 6-storey apartment form where the entire residential floor area is social housing; that height figure is not encoded.
FSR 0.75 outright for one- and two-family dwellings; the Director of Planning may permit up to 1.45 for multiple dwelling, and up to 3.00 where all residential floor area is social housing.
Minimum site area 550 m² for a multiple dwelling.
Site coverage is regulated in §4.8 (relates to form and landscaping); not encoded.

C-1.label: Commercial (local)

use_notes.dwelling: dwelling units only in conjunction with a commercial use, above or behind it; conditional approval

notes: Height 9.2 m outright; the Director of Planning or Development Permit Board may permit up to 10.7 m considering bulk, overlook and views.
Rear yard 10.7 m applies where the building contains residential uses; commercial-only buildings may build closer (confirm §4.6).

C-2.label: Commercial (arterial mixed-use)

use_notes.dwelling: dwelling units above the first storey or at the rear of the first storey, in conjunction with commercial uses; conditional approval

notes: FSR 3.00 for all uses combined, of which not more than 2.50 may be residential.

Height 13.8 m (a 4-storey form) outright. The 2025–26 amendments to C-2, C-2B, C-2C and C-2C1 allow secured rental buildings up to 6 storeys (8 near major transit) by development permit, with 20 % of residential floor area below-market; the taller height in metres is not encoded.
Rear setbacks for residential storeys and the horizontal angle of daylight (§4.6, §4.17) are not encoded: enter the rear yard that applies.
The C-2A district proposed in 2026 (rental and hotels to 8 storeys) is not encoded.

CD-1.label: Comprehensive Development
notes: CD-1 limits are written for the site in its own by-law (cd1-bylaws.vancouver.ca). Enter height, FSR, coverage, yards and permitted uses in the Lot panel.
